scripts.release: bun run commit-release && bun run tag-release
scripts.commit-release: bun -e "const v=require('./package.json').version; require('child_process').execSync(`git add package.json && git commit -m 'release: v${v}' || true`, {stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.tag-release: bun -e "const v=require('./package.json').version; require('child_process').execSync(`git tag v${v} && git push origin main --tags`, {stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.release:patch: bun -e "const fs=require('fs'); const pkg=require('./package.json'); const [a,b,c]=pkg.version.split('.').map(Number); pkg.version=a + '.' + b + '.' + (c + 1); fs.writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + '\n');" && bun run release
